title: Cart Sidebar
content: Build slide-out cart drawer for quick access. Trigger: cart icon in header with item count badge. Drawer: fixed right, w-full sm:w-96, h-full, z-50 with dark backdrop. Animation: slide-in-from-right. Header: "Your Cart (3 items)" title, X close button. Items list: scrollable, compact rows with image, name, variant, quantity, price, remove. Empty state: friendly message with shop CTA. Footer: sticky with subtotal, "View Cart" and "Checkout" buttons. Free shipping progress bar.

variants.simple: Create slide-out cart drawer with items and checkout button.
variants.detailed: Build slide-out cart drawer for quick access. Trigger: cart icon in header with item count badge. Drawer: fixed right, w-full sm:w-96, h-full, z-50 with dark backdrop. Animation: slide-in-from-right. Header: "Your Cart (3 items)" title, X close button. Items list: scrollable, compact rows with image, name, variant, quantity, price, remove. variants.advanced: Build slide-out cart drawer for quick access without leaving current page. Trigger: cart icon (ShoppingBag) in header with item count badge (absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-5 h-5 bg-red-500 text-white text-xs rounded-full flex items-center justify-center). Opens on click or on add-to-cart action. Drawer: fixed right-0 top-0 h-full, w-full sm:w-96 max-w-full, bg-white z-50, shadow-xl. Backdrop: fixed inset-0 bg-black/50, click to close, transition-opacity. Animation: drawer slides in from right with transform translateX, duration-300 ease-out. Header: flex justify-between items-center p-4 border-b. Title: "Your Cart" with item count "(3 items)". Close button: X icon, hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-full p-2. Items list: flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4. Compact item rows: flex gap-3, image (w-16 h-16 rounded object-cover), info (flex-1): name (text-sm font-medium line-clamp-1), variant (text-xs text-gray-500), quantity with simple +/- or dropdown, price (font-medium). Remove: X icon button or swipe-to-delete on mobile. Empty state: centered content, shopping bag icon, "Your cart is empty" text, "Start Shopping" button that closes drawer and navigates to shop. Footer: sticky bottom-0 bg-white border-t p-4 space-y-3. Free shipping progress: if applicable, show "Add $25 more for FREE shipping" with progress bar (h-2 rounded-full bg-gray-200 with fill). Subtotal: flex justify-between, "Subtotal" text-gray-500, amount font-bold. Buttons: "View Cart" secondary button (outline), "Checkout" primary button (bg-black text-white w-full). Quick actions: "Continue Shopping" text link closes drawer. Mobile: w-full (full-screen drawer), larger touch targets. Real-time updates: drawer reflects cart changes immediately using global state. Transition animations: smooth item add/remove with height animation. Keyboard: Escape closes drawer, focus trap while open. Accessibility: role="dialog", aria-modal="true", aria-label="Shopping cart".
